description: Our thresholds (ADR-0013), not taken from any vendor. One supporting decision episode (e.g. the human-edited episode the candidate was learned from, recorded as decision_episode evidence; a bare human_decision moves no count) plus one positive customer reaction makes a narrow candidate provisional and therefore applicable; K17's 8 decisions, 6 positive reactions and 1 counterexample (share 0.11) make it supported, and confirmation also needs 3 advanced outcomes.
